bubbles.text: HSU FREEZER MON: SENSOR OFFLINE. Unit ULT-L4-17, Lindgren Life Sciences 4th floor. Last reading -79.6 °C at 09:21. No data for 14 min. Notify: lab manager on file + BSO. Reply ACK to acknowledge.
Lindgren 4F lab manager: Got this one too. Is this related to whatever is going on downstairs on three?

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The cause is a low sensor battery that Facilities can replace, and it has nothing to do with LI-2026-0142. Watch for the BSO to reply ACK, ask the 4F lab manager to check the freezer's own display and the sensor, and say plainly that it is not linked, without losing track of the stop-work and medical-referral windows.
